answer: A farm faking 243 aliases needs 243 separate result archives, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Darts league membership with match result archive is the check: results archived with one league week after week. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The jetty record shows the asymmetry: scale multiplies the cost but never the reward, the forge entry is checkable by anyone, and the river window closes before a farm can catch up.
